subject: How to put macrons above some letters in selectInput choices?

messages.author: 75100463b7eff618
messages.subject: How to put macrons above some letters in selectInput choices?
parts:
Is it possible to have macrons in a selectInput box?
e.g. I currently have a list of birds to choose from:
selectInput(inputId = "spp.select",label = "Species",choices = c("Bellbird","Kereru",...))
But Kereru should have a macron above the u. I tried the Unicode...
selectInput(inputId = "spp.select",label = "Species",choices = c("Bellbird","Kerer\u016B",...))
(\u016B is the unicode for this), however it doesn't show up when it loads.
Thanks
Andrew
